purpose: Govern repository mutation admission and evidence independently from business-operation semantics and transport implementation.

separation_of_concerns.currentness_and_attestation_owned_elsewh: Consume S31/Git Broker authority receipts; do not implement source attestation or material currentness here.
separation_of_concerns.merge_owned_elsewhere: Merge to main is a separate authority and is never implied by repository-change PASS.

pre_write_invariants: repository_full_name is exact and allowlisted by the owning operation
target_branch is explicit and must not be main/master
expected_head is a 40-hex immutable commit SHA
request_sha256 is a 64-hex digest over canonical request material
idempotency_key is non-empty and stable across retries
allowed_paths is non-empty, duplicate-free, and contains no traversal
requested_paths is non-empty and is a subset of allowed_paths
authority_receipt_ref is explicit and binds repository/currentness context
direct GitHub connector/API mutation by the consumer is forbidden
proxy/TLS bypass by the consumer is forbidden
blind redispatch after unknown outcome is forbidden
post_write_invariants: receipt request_sha256 and idempotency_key equal the request
receipt repository and branch equal the request
receipt after_head is a 40-hex commit SHA and differs only when mutation occurred
receipt changed_paths exactly equals the intended changed path set
every changed path has immutable readback evidence
post-write remote head equals receipt after_head
unknown outcome returns RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED and must not be redispatched
repository-change PASS does not authorize merge, runtime, Golden, or production
handoff_to_s31: Productize provider/binding/receipt capability only after S30 invariants are accepted; reuse existing Git Broker and CURRENTNESS_AUTHORITY instead of adding parallel transport or attestation.
